summary: Mr. Arking explains the community custom of looking at one's fingernails under the light of the Habdalah candle. He discusses the various historical sources and reasons for this practice, while clarifying why the community follows the tradition of looking at the fingernails after reciting the blessing of Boray Meoreh Ha'esh.
questions: Why do we look at our fingernails during Habdalah?
Should I look at my fingernails before or after the blessing?
What is the halachic requirement for the light of the Habdalah candle?
What is the connection between Adam ha-Rishon and the Habdalah candle?
How does the community custom compare to other historical authorities?
